source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: In the Finnish registry cohort, women with NF1 had a significant excess of breast cancer (standardized incidence ratio 3.04) that was greatest under 40 years of age (standardized incidence ratio 11.1), with the youngest cases diagnosed around age 30.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Genet Med 2018;20:671-682; not in PMC). Statement made by the ACMG adult NF1 practice resource citing ref 14 Uusitalo 2016 PMID 26926675. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading. Finnish registry analysis (ref 14, n=1,404 clinically diagnosed NF1, 19,076 person-years). Gutmann 2017 cites the same study (ref 144) for related breast-cancer risk figures; not independent.
independence_flags: secondary citation via guideline PMID 30006586 of ref 14
